messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — I pushed a staging build of the new cost viz for per-route/unit econ. URL: https://staging-console.redwood.local/costs/routes (staging). Please poke, esp around the cache credit rows.
kate: Nice. Quick question: are those cache credits shown at the route-level or the model-level? I see a single number now. :thinking_face:
sanjay: Right now it's aggregated per-tenant. The idea was to keep the UI simple, but product wants per-route clarity for teams doing route-based chargebacks.
ben: I'd vote per-route. Otherwise platform teams won't be able to see how much the 'autocomplete' route is saving vs 'chat' routes.
anya: Agreed with Ben. But we need a deterministic method for splitting shared cache savings. Otherwise we'll have surprise delta between tenant bill and per-route dashboard.
mike: Proposal: attribute cache savings proportionally by non-cached tokens emitted by route during the window. Roughly: credit_route = total_cache_savings * (route_noncached_tokens / sum_noncached_tokens). That keeps tokens as the common unit.
kate: Hmm proportional by non-cached tokens sounds fair but could break when routes have very different model mixes (e.g., small-model routes vs llamax-large). Then cost-per-token differs.
ben: Good point. Maybe compute two columns: "cache_credit_by_tokens" and "cache_credit_by_unit_cost". The latter uses per-model unit price to allocate savings. So teams see both.
anya: That could work. UX: show both but default to tokens. Advanced toggle = "adjust by model unit cost". :+1:
sanjay: Implementation note — telemetry currently emits per-request: route, model, tokens_total, tokens_cached, model_variant. We can do the math in the cost pipeline. Example SQL I sketched for credit-by-cost:
```
WITH route_stats AS (
  SELECT route, model, SUM(tokens_total) AS tokens_total, SUM(tokens_cached) AS tokens_cached
  FROM requests_stream
  WHERE ts BETWEEN :start AND :end
  GROUP BY route, model
), model_prices AS (
  SELECT model, price_per_token
  FROM model_catalog
)
SELECT r.route,
       SUM((r.tokens_total - r.tokens_cached) * m.price_per_token) AS cost_exposed,
       SUM(r.tokens_cached * m.price_per_token) AS cache_credit_by_cost
FROM route_stats r
JOIN model_prices m USING (model)
GROUP BY r.route;
```
mike: That SQL seems fine. We should be careful about double-counting cached tokens: some cached responses are served without charging model compute (e.g., local KV cache). We only want to credit the *avoided billable compute* amount. Our telemetry needs a flag `billing_avoided_tokens` or similar.
anya: Good catch. We have `tokens_cached` today which counts tokens served from cache, but not all cache hits avoid compute (some are cache-warm passthrough). We need to emit `billing_saved_tokens` from runtime. I'll create a small RFC for the runtime change.
ben: For the console, let's add these columns: [tokens_total, tokens_billed, tokens_cached, billing_saved_tokens, cache_credit_tokens, cache_credit_cost, cost_before_cache, cost_after_cache]. Keep them collapsible.
kate: Also need a note in docs: "Cache credit = billing_saved_tokens * model_unit_price" and an explanation of allocation method. Sync with finance so billing and dashboard reconciliation match.
sanjay: Ops question: how does this interact with quotas? If a route is clipped by quota and falls back to a cheaper model, cache credit attribution might flip. We should show a warning/annotation when quota events materially change unit economics.
mike: We can add a small alert icon and hover text showing "X% of tokens were served under fallback due to quota" based on `quota_trigger` telemetry.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: new event schema published to staging: requests_stream v2 includes billing_saved_tokens and quota_trigger flag — schema at /schemas/requests_stream_v2.json
anya: Thanks ingest-bot. I'll update the cost pipeline to consume v2. Plan: compute both allocation modes, then store both snapshots for last-90d. Anyone object?
b...en: No objections. Timeline?
sanjay: If runtime emits v2 tomorrow, eng-data can land pipeline change Wed, and console feature toggle to show both allocations by Fri. Soft launch to beta tenants next week.
kate: Can we add A/B toggle for tenants to opt-in to "cost-per-route" chargeback mode? Some teams prefer tenant-level only.
ben: Add checkbox in billing settings -> "Show per-route cost breakdown (may differ from invoice)". Default off.
anya: One more thought: for historical data we need to backfill. Backfill strategy: re-run cost calculations with cached historical model prices and best-effort billing_saved_tokens (fallback to tokens_cached when billing_saved_tokens missing). Mark those rows as "backfilled".
mike: Sounds good. I'll pair with eng-data on backfill safety checks.
sanjay: Great work. I'll post a short PR with screenshots and the UI toggle later today. Thanks all. :rocket:
